title: Instant Exchange Card Hold
content:
**Returns & Exchanges — customer action reference: the Instant Exchange card hold.**

## The rule

An Instant Exchange card hold is placed only by the cardholder personally, on the card the original order was paid with, for the hold amount of the exchange.

An Instant Exchange card hold against an order is placed only after every return on that order that has passed inspection carries its final-settlement refund.

## What the action does

`place_exchange_hold_2c1506d4` is the cardholder's own consent to an authorization hold on the card used on the original order for an Instant Exchange return, in the amount the agent states. One hold entry is recorded on the return's exchange-hold ledger, dated today; the hold stays open on the card until the returned units are received or the hold is charged. After the call the hold appears among the return's settlement entries as placed.

## How it is invoked

This action belongs to the customer. The agent unlocks it by its exact name, `place_exchange_hold_2c1506d4`, and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it, as the cardholder. The agent does not place the hold on the customer's behalf.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `return_id` | The RMA number of the Instant Exchange return, as shown on the exchange confirmation and by the return lookup | Identifier, exactly as shown |
| `hold_amount_usd` | The hold amount the cardholder consents to | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent, exactly as the agent states it |

## What comes back

- **Success:** a confirmation sentence naming the hold entry reference (a reference beginning "rs"), the RMA number and the amount held on the card in USD with 2 decimal places. The entry reference means the hold was placed.
- **Error:** when no return exists under the RMA number given, the action answers "Error: no return" with that number and records nothing.
